What are the contents of Pradeeps Physics Class 12 Ebook Free Download?
Pradeeps Physics Class 12 Ebook Free Download is divided into two volumes: Volume I and Volume II. Each volume covers different units of physics as per the CBSE syllabus. Here is a brief overview of the contents of each volume:
Volume I
Unit 1 Electrostatics: This unit deals with the study of electric charges at rest and their effects on other charges and fields.
Unit 2 Current Electricity: This unit deals with the study of electric charges in motion and their effects on circuits and devices.
Unit 3 Magnetic Effect of Current and Magnetism: This unit deals with the study of magnetic fields produced by electric currents and magnets and their effects on other currents and magnets.
Unit 4 Electromagnetic Induction & Alternative Currents: This unit deals with the study of electromagnetic induction, which is the phenomenon of generating electric currents by changing magnetic fields, and alternative currents, which are currents that change their direction periodically.
Volume II
Unit 5 -Electromagnetic Waves: This unit deals with the study of electromagnetic waves, which are waves that consist of oscillating electric and magnetic fields that propagate through space.
Unit 6 Optics: This unit deals with the study of light and its properties, such as reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, polarization, etc.
Unit 7 Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter: This unit deals with the study of the dual nature of radiation and matter, which means that they can exhibit both wave-like and particle-like behavior depending on the situation.
Unit 8 Atoms and Nuclei: This unit deals with the study of atoms and nuclei, which are the basic units of matter and consist of subatomic particles such as protons, neutrons, electrons, etc.
Unit 9 Electronic Devices: This unit deals with the study of electronic devices, such as diodes, transistors, logic gates, etc., that use electric currents to perform various functions.
Unit 10 Communication Systems: This unit deals with the study of communication systems, such as radio, television, telephone, internet, etc., that use electromagnetic waves to transmit information from one place to another.
